formal_role: Identifies the parameter varied to study qualitative change
systems_modeling_role: Represents stress forcing growth coupling recovery policy or external condition
review_warning: The parameter must have a clear interpretation and documented range

formal_role: Marks where the model changes qualitative behavior
systems_modeling_role: Represents a possible threshold tipping condition or regime boundary
review_warning: Critical values may be theoretical estimated scenario-based or policy-defined

formal_role: Tracks equilibrium values as the parameter changes
systems_modeling_role: Shows possible steady states under changing conditions
review_warning: Branches must be checked against meaningful domains and units

formal_role: Labels branches as stable unstable or inconclusive
systems_modeling_role: Supports interpretation of attraction fragility threshold behavior or collapse
review_warning: Local stability labels should not be treated as global resilience claims

formal_role: Represents path-dependent behavior where recovery differs from collapse
systems_modeling_role: Explains why undoing stress may not restore the previous state
review_warning: Hysteresis claims require careful evidence and parameter-path documentation

formal_role: Defines the parameter grid or continuation step used in computation
systems_modeling_role: Shapes how precisely critical values and branches are detected
review_warning: Coarse parameter sweeps can miss or misplace bifurcations
